capabilities.problem: Research directions can be recommended despite missing evidence or infeasible materials; revision history and useful alternatives can be lost.
capabilities.mechanism: Record external five-axis assessments with source bindings, local disposition gates, retained revisions and a prehuman proposal report with linked excerpts, source snapshots and explicit missing metadata.

hard_measures: Version-bound assessments and retained substantive revisions
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent evaluation judges opportunity validity and the adequacy of revisions.

hard_measures: Eligible recommendations, blocked unknowns, traceable dispositions and shared event projections
metric_effects.human_judgment: An internal recommendation does not establish scientific value or improved external scores.

guardrails: Unknown is not zero or verified
A failed alternative does not erase an eligible recommendation
Keep native tools and independent evaluation separate

capabilities.problem: Gap-only framing can suppress evidence-motivated method ideas; unsupported claims, infeasible prerequisites and lost revisions still need checks.
capabilities.mechanism: Support improvements to existing methods and new concepts before the same source-bound five-axis assessment; retain revisions and distinguish untested outcomes from missing enabling evidence.
